worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.summary: Burns its own armor into a blazing shell and fires it: a long-range special shot whose impact leaves scorched ground. Firing lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by one stage each, hit or miss. The bursting form detonates on impact to catch those around the landing point, at the cost of lower single-target power.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.use.0: Pick off a target at range with one armor-shell shot
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.use.1: Bursting form to blast foes bunched around the landing point
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.use.2: Fire from afar and leave scorched ground behind
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.descriptio: Fires the blazing armor shell for about %1$s special damage on a hit.
Range %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s-block projectile radius.
The armor is burned away before the shell leaves: the user's Defense drops %1$s stage(s) and Sp. Def drops %2$s, hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.burst.on: Bursting form: the impact detonates a %1$s-block radius fireball, catching other foes around the landing point for %2$s of the shot's power.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.burst.off: Single form: all power on one target, with a faster cast and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.growth.0: From level %1$s the shell power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.growth.1: From level %1$s the shell power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.preference: On: the shell detonates in a multi-block radius, catching other foes around the landing point for a share of the power; costs shell power x0.8, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off (single): all power on one target, faster cast.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first; larger is willing to ignite from farther out.
At or beyond this distance it scores higher, encouraging fire from afar; within 2 blocks it scores lower so close-range options take over.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one shot finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Armor Cannon back (0 = no limit). Higher saves the shot for a worthwhile trade.
worldcombat.skill.armorcannon.descriptio: When the shell hits or bursts on an obstacle, the landing burns into scorched ground in a %1$s-block radius for %2$s ticks, after which the original blocks return; a shell that flies out without connecting leaves none.
